claim: On sv10043 (v26.40.8-7a95011) a tester cannot create, from the screen, an asset with no year, make or model: both New Asset forms refuse to save without a Make

positive_control.evidence: Same form, same script method saved '2022 Freightliner Em2 106 TRK-118' and '1999 Ford Explorer' (no unit) in this run (new-asset-after-save.txt, asset-ford-no-unit.txt; wob29/wob31 logs).

tried_through_the_screen.evidence: Clicked through the real UI: Customers > customer > Assets tab > New Asset > pick Contact > Save (asset-no-make.txt), and Work Orders > Create Work Order > Asset Add > pick Contact > Save (wo-asset-add-no-make-0.txt, -1.txt).

waited_and_retried.evidence: Three attempts over two forms (wob31 A, wob32 try 0 and try 1), each after a 3 s settle; same red message each time: 'Make is a required field'.

checked_for_navigation.evidence: Dialog stayed open with the field error; no URL change, no new tab, no toast (overlay text captured in wob31.log / wob32.log).

precondition_read_back.evidence: The customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge Commercial' and its contact 'ZZAUTOTEST Contact' existed and were picked in the Contact field before Save (overlay shows 'Contact * ZZAUTOTEST Contact').

searched_the_repo.evidence: git grep 'Make is a required field' and 'asset ... no make / without a make' across build/: no hits; ls build/BLOCKED-*.md: none about assets.

asked_what_would_make_this_my_fault.evidence: Most likely my fault: picking a contact failed, so the save refused for another reason. Ruled out: the error shown is on Make specifically and the Contact field shows the chosen contact; with a Make filled the same form saves. An asset with no make could still arrive by import, which is not a hand route.
